subject: Future Tech
title: Play-to-Earn Gaming
description: A quick, practical guide to Play-to-Earn Gaming.

hook.text: Axie Infinity let players in the Philippines earn real income by battling digital creatures and selling tokens.

buildup.text: At its peak in 2021, some Filipino players earned more from Axie than from their regular jobs during the pandemic.

discovery.text: Play-to-earn flipped the model: instead of paying to play, players extract value by investing time in the game.

twist.text: Axie's economy collapsed when token prices crashed. Players who invested savings lost everything almost overnight.

climax.text: Sustainable game economies remain unsolved. Most play-to-earn models depend on new players funding old ones.

punchline.text: When the game is the job, the crash hits like a layoff.

quiz.question: Why did Axie Infinity's economy collapse?
